events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place over three days in Bethel, New York, starting on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million people descended on a farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock & Roll
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music continues to shake, rattle, and roll through the generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Anniversary
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996, and would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who left us far too soon. His lyrics and legacy continue to resonate, 29 years on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away in London in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who redefined what a guitar could do. His music still sounds as revolutionary today.

events.title: 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1 or 3, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' continues to be a masterpiece. What's your favourite song from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' frontwoman still rocks harder than most. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Power of Imagine
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still inspires hope and peace around the world. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising portable music, in 2001.

angles.name: Remember the iPod
angles.copy: Cast your mind back 25 years... The first iPod dropped, changing how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the girls, the cars to the theme tunes – what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon, born on October 9, 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Python to Fawlty Towers. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, born on September 5, 1946, passed away on November 24, 1991, and would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the one-of-a-kind Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
